title: Factual applications / information and report
slide_intent: Preserve hierarchy in quieter communications so readers can find the main subject without decorative competition.
strategic_value: A restrained dark field and small identity cues can connect DB information and reporting.
demonstration: A passenger-service information card and an Immer besser report cover share dark grounds and restrained red branding.
practical_value: Compare how a photograph-led information card and a type-led cover establish hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Information card
content_islands.spec: Place the station photograph above the passenger-service heading and explanatory text.

content_islands.name: Report cover
content_islands.spec: Place the small mark above the centered title and the rising sleeper graphic at the lower edge.

reference_purposes.Application: The pair demonstrates factual information and report-cover treatments.
